name: RSS Reader
description: Subscribe to RSS 2.0, RDF and Atom feeds and read, group, search and annotate articles in a DBX workbench. Includes OPML import/export, favorites with content snapshots, and a local-only JSON store.
releaseNotes: Initial release: RSS 2.0 / RSS 1.0 (RDF) / Atom 1.0 subscriptions, groups, unread filtering, search and pagination, OPML preview/import/export, article extraction, a focus reader, favorites and annotations, and a size/type-checked image proxy. Unsigned x64 packages for Windows, Linux and macOS.

zh-CN.name: RSS 阅读器
zh-CN.description: 订阅 RSS/RDF/Atom 源，在 DBX 工作台中分组、搜索、收藏和批注文章；支持 OPML 导入导出，数据仅保存在本机。
